Dune Bashing in Jaisalmer

Fast, bumpy 4x4 rides over the dunes — an adrenaline-led add-on to a desert evening. Ask the operator about seat belts and driver experience before you go.

Explore this activity ↗

What to expect

  • 4x4 drive over sand dunes
  • Steep dune climbs and drops
  • Group fun

Where and when

Sam dunes.

Late afternoon.

Before you go

Ask which vehicle and seats are offered, whether everyone has a working seat belt and whether a gentler route is available. Agree the pickup point before leaving camp.
